newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sell steady-up $1, active-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sell steady-up $1, active-USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was fairly active, with live sales fully steady; dressed basis fully steady, with an occasional set $1.00 per cwt higher, USDA said. Confirmed- 15,000 Last Week - 15,500 Last Year - 37,900 Wk To Date- 73,000 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 74,100 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 56,700
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - 64.00-65.00, few Choice blacks 65.50; dressed basis 104.00, instances 105.00. ( weighted average 104.07).
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs - 64.00-65.00; dressed basis 104.00, instances to 103.00, few 105.00. (weighted average 103.96).
Buyer inquiry was good and seller interest uneven. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
